title: The Best Side Hustle for Beginners (Any Age)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The guests direct listeners to Resell University and mention a course they may launch, which may bias their recommendations.

idea.name: Used goods and electronics reselling
idea.one_liner: Buy underpriced used goods, especially consumer electronics, then resell them individually or in bulk through online marketplaces.
idea.customer: Online buyers and bulk resellers, including flea market vendors.
idea.offer: Tested, working used electronics and other secondhand goods at below-new prices.
idea.revenue_model: Buy inventory below resale value and earn a margin by selling items on eBay or in bulk to other resellers.

acquisition_channels.details: Buy inventory from eBay and Facebook Marketplace; sell items on eBay and sometimes in bulk to marketplace buyers.
Source from thrift stores, yard sales and flea markets.
Call domestic suppliers, junk removal companies and electronics sellers to arrange bulk purchases.
Find supplier contact details online and email them about buying inventory in bulk.
Build repeat supplier and buyer relationships so contacts offer new stock.

ideas.delivery: The reseller sources goods, tests and photographs them, lists them online, and packs and ships orders; some working stock is sold in bulk to resellers.
